scope: Independent synthetic RGB rasterizer and conditional fake receipts; no physical owner oracle

rules.positive: Visible bilateral longitudinal rails and visible bilateral body/background terminal transition support endpoints. A known-down fake receipt with unique measured line and visible body contact has a legitimate Move opportunity.
rules.negative: A measured white line or isolated white dots do not independently establish bilateral rails. Unknown/completed receipts do not acquire or revive actions. Observable separate historical extents merging into one region remain ambiguous.
rules.occlusion: Completely unobservable endpoints are unknown; a small body is not intrinsically invalid. Do not substitute all-refuse success for capability.
rules.stationary: Repeated identical descriptors do not gain independent confirmation under frozen BVI-1. New stationary-note/relative-line-motion opportunity is a separate capability decision, not evidence that rails/endpoints repair solved it.
rules.metamorphic: Integer translation and representable rotation preserve observable shape semantics; region/line permutation cannot change action eligibility or select one ambiguous line by order.

expect.question: Whether relative line motion can provide new legitimate acquisition evidence without descriptor novelty; no rail patch claim.
A short body remains visible but longitudinal rail evidence may be insufficient; report result, do not award refusal pass.
Current blue contact exists at body angle .25 versus line .4; fixed flank sampling may miss it. Report observed capability without changing frozen contact oracle.
Identical legal observations cannot identify one or multiple physical Holds. Equal outputs required; neither rejection nor action is credited as physical correctness.

denominator_policy: Report legal_action_opportunity and safe_denial as separate case denominators, with assertion totals. Geometry/metamorphic/decision-only reported separately. Decision-only cases do not increase pass count. All failures retained.
